card.name: The word if before 'they occur'
card.fires_on: The word "if" in patient-instruction sentences, right before "they occur" and after a phrase about notifying the physician or steps to take.

modes.label: Steps to take if symptoms occur
modes.description: "if" follows an instruction about what the patient should do, and introduces a clause about symptoms occurring.
modes.example: Patients should be informed about the symptoms of serious CV events and the steps to take<< if>> they occur.

modes.label: Notify the physician if
modes.description: "if" follows an instruction to notify the physician immediately.
modes.example: the patient should be instructed to notify the physician immediately<< if>> they occur (see also PRECAUTION

card.plain: It marks the word "if" in warnings telling patients what to do when symptoms occur.
evidence: the patient should be instructed to notify the physician immediately<< if>> they occur (see also PRECAUTION
